definitions.gloss: to jump across, to leap to
definitions.explanation: To move from one place to another by jumping, often across a gap or between elevated surfaces.

definitions.gloss: to spread (fire, disease), to jump to
definitions.explanation: For something like fire or disease to spread by jumping from one place or host to another.

examples.english: Monkeys leap from tree to tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{移|うつ}った。
examples.english: I jumped from the boat to the shore.
The fire spread to the neighboring house.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{宿主|しゅくしゅ}→宿主：29662_shukushu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る。
examples.english: The virus jumps to a new host.

examples.japanese: ⟦リス→リス：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{移|うつ}っていた。
examples.english: Squirrels were leaping from roof to roof.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{火|ひ}の{粉|こ}→火の粉：13430_hinoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{移|うつ}り、⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{燃|も}えた→燃える：02312_moeru⟧。
examples.english: Sparks spread from house to house in the strong wind, and homes burned one after another.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly, jump) + ⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧ (to move, transfer) = to jump and move to another place

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive. Uses ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧ to mark the destination, and ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ to mark the origin.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る (to leap from tree to tree)
・⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る (fire spreads)
・⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る (to jump from roof to roof)

USAGE NOTE: In sense 2, this verb is commonly used in news and scientific contexts to describe the spread of fire or infectious diseases.

RELATED {飛|と}び～ COMPOUND VERBS:

・⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}す→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧ - to jump out, to rush out
・⟦{飛|と}び{越|こ}える→飛び越える：04616_tobikoeru⟧ - to jump over
